item.title: Kenyan Activists Seek Court Halt on Deployment of “High-Risk” AI Systems
item.description: Human rights activists have filed a petition at the High Court in Kerugoya seeking urgent orders to halt the deployment of what they describe as “high-risk artificial intelligence systems” in Kenya.
